name: Yosemite Valley
desc: A famous glacier-carved canyon located in the heart of Yosemite, where park reveals its most iconic landscape: Enjoy granite cliffs, and towering waterfalls.

name: Half Dome
desc: Rising nearly 5,000 feet above Yosemite Valley and 8,800 feet above sea level, Half Dome is a true icon of Yosemite. Look at the amazing shape of this granite dome, literally 'cut in half'.

name: El Capitan
desc: This iconic granite formation, rising over 3,000 feet above the meadow, is a small universe of Yosemite. At night, climbers headlamps are the stars, and El Capitan shines like the moon.

name: The Historic Jeffrey Pine
desc: This gnarled mountaintop veteran were immortalized by Ansel Adams and countless other shutterbugs. Its bleached wood, though, remains a stirring sight—and an amazing meditation on the passage of time!

name: Yosemite Falls
desc: This is true diamond in Yosemite Valley -- the tallest waterfall in entire North America rising 2,425 feet.
